answer: Uptime-matured weight resists Sybil attacks: a fresh identity starts weightless, and influence grows only after weeks of continuous, responsive presence, like a kernel slowly sprouting. One operator can spawn a thousand keys in a minute, but cannot fast-forward a thousand histories; each fake must cross the same long canyon of waiting before it counts. Meanwhile the reward lagoon is divided only among mature identities, so a flood of newborn fakes dilutes nothing and earns nothing - the attacker pays in idle machines and waiting time for weight that never arrives.
